完整備份包含所有檔案；增量備份每次都有完整的資料庫，檔案只存上次備份後新增或變更: A full backup holds every file; an incremental one always holds the whole database but only the files added or changed since the previous backup — a restore fetches the rest from the earlier backups and verifies every checksum. Each backup checks that every attachment the database records is there. Backups older than the days to keep are deleted, except those an incremental backup still needs.
